name: dialectcn
summary: Feed of shadcn presets — brand-inspired, community-submitted and random — previewed on live UI blocks.
description: A catalog of shadcn presets: each preset pairs a color palette with a typography pairing (for example Public Sans with Roboto Slab) and is previewed on a demo interface of shadcn/ui blocks, charts, tables, forms and settings. Browse the feed, submit your own preset, then copy the code to ship the UI.
